The repo has no .rubocop.yml or coding-standards file. ponytail #9 relies on the user's ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, not a repo document.\n- Model diversity: no reviewer from another model family took a seat.\n\nMerge policy:\n- A seat counts toward agreement when its report asserts the defect at that location, including out-of-remit notes. On that basis, main-list membership of the url XSS, raw_html bypass and end if findings relies on mattpocock's notes. Membership of the PollFeed-amplification and protocol-relative findings relies on ponytail's notes.\n- One rejection: open-code-review's Ruby 2.0 scrub claim, disproved by mattpocock's citation of lib/freedom_patches/scrub.rb.\n- No verifier dispatch was needed."}
